name: HDFC Millennia Credit Card
fee_waiver: Annual fee waived on spend of INR 1,00,000 in a year
rewards: 5% cashback on Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Swiggy, Zomato, Uber, BookMyShow, Cult.fit, Sony LIV, Tata CLiQ; 1% on all other spends
best_for: Online shoppers, millennials, food delivery and ride-hailing users
perks: 8 complimentary domestic airport lounge visits per year, 1% fuel surcharge waiver, 20% off at partner restaurants via Good Food Trail
income_requirement: Salaried INR 35,000/month or self-employed INR 6 lakh/year ITR

name: Amazon Pay ICICI Credit Card
rewards: 5% cashback on Amazon.in for Prime members, 3% for non-Prime, 2% on 100+ Amazon Pay partner merchants, 1% on all other spends
best_for: Heavy Amazon shoppers, first-time credit card users who want no annual fee
perks: No joining/annual fee, 1% fuel surcharge waiver at any petrol pump in India
income_requirement: Based on ICICI internal credit assessment; available to new-to-credit customers

name: SBI SimplyCLICK Credit Card
fee_waiver: Annual fee reversed on spend of INR 1,00,000 in previous year
rewards: 10X reward points on Amazon, BookMyShow, Cleartrip, Swiggy, Apollo 24x7; 5X on other online spends; 1 reward point per INR 100 otherwise
best_for: Budget online shoppers who want low annual fee and online spend rewards
perks: Cleartrip e-voucher worth INR 500 on joining; INR 2,000 Cleartrip vouchers on annual online spends of INR 1 lakh and INR 2 lakh

name: Axis Bank ACE Credit Card
fee_waiver: Annual fee waived on spend of INR 2,00,000 in a year
rewards: 5% cashback on bill payments, DTH and mobile recharges via Google Pay; 4% on Swiggy, Zomato, Ola; 2% on all other spends
best_for: Users who pay utility bills via Google Pay and use food delivery / cabs frequently
perks: 4 complimentary domestic lounge visits per year, 1% fuel surcharge waiver

name: HDFC Regalia Gold Credit Card
fee_waiver: Annual fee waived on spend of INR 4,00,000 in a year
rewards: 4 reward points per INR 150 on all spends; 20 reward points per INR 150 on Marks & Spencer, Myntra, Nykaa, Reliance Digital
best_for: Mid-to-premium users who travel and dine out regularly
perks: 12 complimentary domestic + 6 international lounge visits per year (Priority Pass), complimentary Club Vistara Silver and MMT Black memberships, INR 1,500 voucher on quarterly spends of INR 1.5 lakh
income_requirement: Salaried INR 1 lakh/month or self-employed INR 12 lakh/year ITR

name: American Express Membership Rewards Credit Card
fee_waiver: No automatic waiver; bonus points on reaching spend milestones
rewards: 1 Membership Reward point per INR 50; bonus 1,000 points on 4 transactions of INR 1,500+ per month
best_for: Users who want flexible travel rewards and prefer premium customer service
perks: Wide range of redemption options including 24K gold collection, airline miles transfer (Marriott, Etihad, Singapore Airlines etc.), exclusive dining offers

name: HDFC Diners Club Black Credit Card
fee_waiver: Annual fee waived on spend of INR 8,00,000 in a year
rewards: 5 reward points per INR 150 on all retail spends; 10X on SmartBuy (MakeMyTrip, Yatra, Cleartrip etc.)
best_for: Frequent international travellers and high spenders
perks: Unlimited complimentary airport lounge access worldwide, 6 complimentary golf games per quarter, 2x complimentary Club Marriott / Amazon Prime / Swiggy One / Times Prime memberships on annual spends, low forex markup
income_requirement: Salaried INR 17.5 lakh/year or self-employed INR 21 lakh/year ITR

name: SBI Cashback Credit Card
fee_waiver: Annual fee reversed on spend of INR 2,00,000 in previous year
rewards: 5% cashback on all online spends (except merchant category exclusions like rent, wallet loads, utilities), 1% on offline spends
best_for: Pure online shoppers who want flat unrestricted online cashback
perks: 1% fuel surcharge waiver (INR 500 to INR 3,000 transactions)

name: Flipkart Axis Bank Credit Card
fee_waiver: Annual fee waived on spend of INR 2,00,000 in a year
rewards: 5% cashback on Flipkart, Cleartrip, Myntra; 4% on preferred partners (Swiggy, Uber, PVR, Cultfit); 1.5% on all other spends
best_for: Regular Flipkart/Myntra shoppers and cab/food-delivery users
perks: 4 complimentary domestic lounge visits per year, INR 600 Flipkart voucher on joining, 1% fuel surcharge waiver

name: IDFC FIRST Select Credit Card
rewards: 10X points on spends above INR 20,000/month and on birthday spends; 6X on spends up to INR 20,000; 3X on online spends; 1X on EMI; points never expire
best_for: Users who want a lifetime-free card with flexible rewards across categories
perks: 4 complimentary domestic lounge + 4 railway lounge visits per quarter, low forex markup of 1.99%, roadside assistance worth INR 1,399, 20% discount at partner restaurants

name: Axis Bank Magnus Credit Card
fee_waiver: Annual fee waived on spend of INR 25,00,000 in a year
rewards: 12 EDGE reward points per INR 200; 25,000 bonus points on spend of INR 1 lakh in a calendar month; travel transfers to 20+ airline/hotel partners
best_for: Premium travel enthusiasts and high spenders who want maximum travel value
perks: Unlimited international and domestic lounge access (Priority Pass), BookMyShow BOGO, Tata CLiQ / Luxe vouchers on milestone spends, complimentary golf rounds, concierge
income_requirement: Salaried INR 1.5 lakh/month or ITR of INR 18 lakh/year

name: ICICI Coral Credit Card
fee_waiver: Annual fee waived on spend of INR 1,50,000 in a year
rewards: 2 PAYBACK points per INR 100 on all spends (except fuel); 1 PAYBACK point per INR 100 on utility and insurance
best_for: Entry-level premium users who want lounge access and dining discounts at a low fee
perks: 4 complimentary domestic lounge visits per year, 15% off on dining via Culinary Treats, 1% fuel surcharge waiver, BookMyShow offers

name: Standard Chartered Smart Credit Card
fee_waiver: Annual fee waived on spend of INR 1,20,000 in a year
rewards: 2% cashback on online spends, 1% cashback on offline spends, as reward points
best_for: Users looking for simple, flat cashback on both online and offline spends
perks: EMI conversion on spends above INR 2,000, 1% fuel surcharge waiver

name: Indian Oil HDFC Bank Credit Card
fee_waiver: Annual fee waived on spend of INR 50,000 in a year
rewards: 5% back as fuel points on IndianOil outlets; 5% on groceries and bill payments (capped); 1% on other spends
best_for: Users with high fuel spends at Indian Oil petrol pumps
perks: 1% fuel surcharge waiver at Indian Oil pumps, redeem fuel points directly for free fuel

name: Air India SBI Signature Credit Card
rewards: 30 reward points per INR 100 on Air India ticket bookings; 4 reward points per INR 100 on other spends; 1 reward point = 1 Air India mile
best_for: Frequent Air India flyers who want to accrue miles quickly
perks: Complimentary Air India Frequent Flyer Golden Edge Club membership, 2 complimentary international + 8 domestic lounge visits per year, 20,000 bonus miles on joining

name: RBL Bank ShopRite Credit Card
fee_waiver: Annual fee waived on spend of INR 75,000 in a year
rewards: 20 reward points per INR 100 on grocery spends (up to 1,000 points/month); 2 points per INR 100 on other spends
best_for: Households with high grocery spending who want an entry-level grocery card
perks: 1% fuel surcharge waiver, EMI on spends above INR 3,000

name: BPCL SBI Octane Credit Card
fee_waiver: Annual fee reversed on spend of INR 2,00,000 in previous year
rewards: 25 reward points per INR 100 on BPCL fuel, groceries, departmental stores and movies; 10 points per INR 100 on dining and utility; 1 point per INR 100 on others
best_for: BPCL-loyal customers with high fuel and household spends
perks: 4 complimentary domestic lounge visits per year, 1% fuel surcharge waiver at BPCL, 6.25% value back on BPCL fuel

name: Au Bank LIT Credit Card
fee_waiver: Lifetime free (feature packs can be activated/deactivated as needed)
rewards: Customisable feature packs: choose from 10X points on shopping/travel/dining/fuel, cashback, or low forex markup for 3 months at a time
best_for: Users who want a flexible card with features they can switch on/off per quarter
perks: Feature-based lounge access, fuel surcharge waiver and concierge when activated
